cause: Survey boundary overlap between Khasra 45 and 46 causing demarcation conflict with adjoining landholders
task_type_original: Conducted joint DGPS survey with Revenue Inspector and Village Patwari. Erected permanent RCC boundary pillars at verified coordinates. Updated digitized Khasra map in state GIS portal. Issue resolved in 12 days.

cause: Drone orthophoto survey pending for 3 months due to monsoon season and equipment unavailability at district level
task_type_original: Requisitioned DGPS RTK equipment from neighboring district under inter-district sharing protocol. Completed drone orthophoto mapping during clear weather window. Generated Digital Elevation Model for 450 hectares. Survey completed in 18 days post-equipment arrival.

cause: Original stone boundary pillars from 1975 settlement survey missing due to agricultural encroachment in village Rampur
task_type_original: Arranged re-survey with Deputy Director of Land Records office using historical cadastral maps. Identified original survey coordinates from 1975 records. Installed new concrete pillars with GPS coordinates etched. Photographed and geo-tagged each pillar location.

cause: Multiple claimants presenting conflicting title deeds for Khasra 112 in village Khalsa Majra. Partition suit pending in civil court since 2019
task_type_original: Filed expedited hearing application under Section 64 RFCTLARR Act. Court appointed Commissioner for local verification. Deposited compensation in Reference Court for disputed portion under Section 77. Allowed undisputed 70% land to proceed with acquisition while title suit continues.

cause: 30-year non-encumbrance certificate pending from Sub-Registrar office for 23 parcels since 4 months
task_type_original: Escalated to District Registrar office. Deployed special team for manual search of old registration records pre-digitization era. Obtained 19 of 23 certificates within 2 weeks. For remaining 4 parcels arranged sworn affidavit route with revenue officer attestation.

cause: High Court stay order on acquisition proceedings for 12 hectares in Mohal Sultanpur due to PIL challenging environmental impact assessment
task_type_original: Filed vacation application with detailed EIA compliance affidavit. Provided supplementary environmental clearance documents from State Pollution Control Board. Court modified stay to allow acquisition proceedings while environmental compliance monitoring continues. Appointed independent environmental auditor.

cause: Deceased landholder heirs unable to produce succession certificate. 5 legal heirs claiming separate shares in 3.5 acre parcel
task_type_original: Facilitated application to SDM court for succession certificate under simplified process. Arranged legal aid for below-poverty-line heirs. Revenue officer conducted family tree verification through village records. Certificate issued in 35 days. Compensation disbursed proportionally to all legal heirs.

cause: DBT payment of Rs 45 lakh compensation stuck for 67 landholders due to Aadhaar-bank account mismatch in PFMS portal
task_type_original: Organized special camp at village panchayat office with bank representatives and UIDAI verification team. Corrected 54 Aadhaar-bank seeding mismatches on spot. Remaining 13 cases resolved through manual NPCI mapper correction. Full disbursement completed within 3 weeks via PFMS e-payment gateway.

cause: Landholders challenging compensation rate claiming actual market value is 3x higher than circle rate used for calculation
task_type_original: Constituted special valuation committee with District Revenue Officer and registered valuer. Collected 3 years of registered sale deed data from Sub-Registrar. Applied multiplication factor 1.5x as per RFCTLARR First Schedule for rural area. Added 100% solatium and 12% annual escalation. Revised award accepted by 78% landholders. Remaining referred to LARR Authority.

cause: Solatium amount incorrectly calculated at 50% instead of mandatory 100% for 34 award holders in Phase-2 acquisition
task_type_original: Detected systematic error in compensation software formula. Issued immediate corrigendum to all 34 award holders. Recalculated with correct 100% solatium as per RFCTLARR Act Section 30(1). Disbursed differential amount within 10 working days. Updated software calculation module to prevent recurrence.

cause: Section 11 notification published but individual awards not declared for 89 parcels in 6 months exceeding statutory timeline
task_type_original: Deployed additional revenue staff from adjacent tehsil. Conducted parallel joint measurement survey teams covering 15 parcels per day. Completed individual award calculations using updated market data. Published awards in batches of 20 in district gazette. Completed all 89 awards in 45 days.

cause: Resettlement colony for 45 displaced families lacks basic water supply connection and approach road. Families refusing to vacate
task_type_original: Issued emergency work order to PWD contractor for approach road construction. Coordinated with Jal Shakti department for water pipeline extension from nearest junction 2.3 km away. Installed 3 community standposts with overhead tank. Road completed in 28 days. Water supply operational in 40 days. Families began voluntary relocation.

cause: 156 agricultural laborer families losing primary livelihood source. No alternative employment plan prepared as mandated under RFCTLARR Second Schedule
task_type_original: Partnered with District Industries Center and NABARD for skill development training in construction trades. Enrolled 89 workers in PMKVY scheme. Facilitated 34 self-help group formations for micro-enterprise loans. Arranged priority employment with project contractor for 67 eligible workers. Issued one-time subsistence allowance of Rs 36000 to all affected families.

cause: 12 displaced families disputing R&R plot sizes claiming allotted 100 sqm plots are smaller than entitled 150 sqm as per R&R scheme
task_type_original: Re-measured allotted plots using licensed surveyor. Found 8 plots were indeed undersized due to layout planning error. Issued revised allotment letters with correct dimensions from alternative block. Compensated 4 families with additional cash differential where physical expansion was not feasible. Updated R&R site layout plan.

cause: Stage-1 Forest Clearance for 23 hectare forest land diversion pending with MoEFCC for 14 months. No response after Regional Office recommendation
task_type_original: Filed compliance report on Parivesh portal with complete documentation package. Submitted compensatory afforestation land proposal for 46 hectare non-forest land identified in adjacent block. Deposited NPV amount Rs 2.3 crore in CAMPA account. Arranged meeting with Regional Chief Conservator of Forests. Stage-1 approval received in 60 days after complete submission.

cause: Suitable non-forest land for compensatory afforestation not identified despite 8 months search. Revenue department unable to provide degraded forest land in same district
task_type_original: Expanded search to adjacent districts under relaxed CA guidelines. Identified 34 hectare degraded revenue wasteland in neighboring district through satellite imagery analysis. Obtained District Collector consent for CA land transfer. Submitted CA proposal with planting scheme to State Forest Department for approval. Land transfer completed in 4 months.

cause: Tree enumeration and marking for 2800 trees in proposed alignment not completed. DFO team citing staff shortage and dense terrain
task_type_original: Arranged supplementary field staff from Social Forestry Division under DFO directive. Deployed GPS-enabled mobile enumeration app for faster field data collection. Completed enumeration in 3 phases covering 900+ trees per phase. Generated species-wise enumeration report with girth classification. Total enumeration completed in 35 working days.

cause: Project alignment passes within 10 km of wildlife sanctuary buffer zone. Wildlife Board NOC not applied due to confusion over applicability
task_type_original: Consulted with Chief Wildlife Warden for formal applicability assessment. Submitted wildlife impact assessment report prepared by Wildlife Institute empanelled consultant. Applied for Standing Committee of National Board for Wildlife clearance through Parivesh portal. Obtained conditional clearance with wildlife passage corridor mitigation measures in 90 days.

cause: 35 landholders refusing to give physical possession despite full compensation payment. Demanding higher compensation and threatening legal action
task_type_original: Issued 15-day statutory vacation notice under Section 38 RFCTLARR Act. Arranged conciliation meeting with SDM and Block Development Officer. 22 landholders agreed after clarification of solatium and interest computation. For remaining 13 refusing possession SDM ordered administrative possession with police protection. Possession panchnama recorded with two independent witnesses.

cause: Fresh encroachment detected on 4 hectare acquired government land in village Garhi. Unauthorized brick kiln constructed after acquisition notification
task_type_original: Filed complaint with SDM office under Public Premises Eviction Act. Revenue team served eviction notice with 7-day compliance deadline. Demolished unauthorized structure with executive magistrate supervision. Erected boundary fencing with geo-tagged survey pillars. Deployed security guard and installed CCTV monitoring at entry points. Filed FIR against encroacher.

cause: Standing wheat crop on 15 acquired parcels totaling 28 hectares. Farmers requesting 3-month harvest delay before giving possession
task_type_original: Assessed crop maturity with agriculture department officer. Allowed 45-day harvest window for mature crop parcels. For remaining parcels compensated standing crop at market rate plus 50% premium as per district crop valuation schedule. Possession taken in phased manner post-harvest. All possession panchnamas completed within 60 days.

cause: Revenue map and satellite imagery showing 23% area discrepancy for 67 parcels in Tehsil Dhampur creating confusion in measurement
task_type_original: Deployed CORS-enabled DGPS survey to establish ground truth coordinates. Cross-verified with historical settlement records from 1952 and 1985 resurvey data. Found systematic projection error in digitized revenue maps. Corrected digital maps using Survey of India geodetic benchmarks. Issued certified corrected Khasra maps to all 67 parcel holders.

cause: Acquisition covers 3 villages where cadastral maps still exist only in cloth tracing format from 1960s. No digital records available
task_type_original: Engaged state GIS agency for emergency digitization of cloth maps. High-resolution scanning at 600 DPI with manual vectorization of parcel boundaries. Cross-referenced with available mutation records. Created digital Khasra maps integrated with state DILRMP portal. Training provided to local Patwari on digital map usage. Completed in 45 days.

cause: Group of 28 landholders filed writ petition in High Court challenging Social Impact Assessment study methodology and public hearing validity
task_type_original: Filed detailed counter-affidavit with complete SIA documentation and public hearing proceedings minutes. Submitted video recordings of public hearing conducted at 3 village locations. Provided published SIA report with expert panel signatures. Court dismissed petition finding SIA compliant with Section 4 RFCTLARR Act procedural requirements. Acquisition proceedings resumed after 75 days.

cause: 12% per annum interest from notification to award date not added to compensation for 156 landholders due to software configuration error
task_type_original: Identified interest calculation module error in LA management software. Manually computed interest for all 156 cases from Section 11 notification date to award date. Generated supplementary award letters with interest differential amounts. Disbursed additional payments through PFMS within 15 working days. Software vendor issued patch to prevent future computation errors.

cause: Joint measurement survey for 234 parcels pending due to revenue staff deployed for election duty. 4-month delay in survey initiation
task_type_original: Requested District Collector to depute additional revenue staff post-election period. Arranged 4 parallel survey teams with DGPS equipment from state survey department. Conducted village-wise measurement camps with advance notice to landholders. Completed all 234 parcel measurements in 28 working days. Joint measurement sheets signed by all participating landholders and revenue officials.

cause: Intelligence report indicating 8 parcels in acquisition zone may involve benami transactions. Compensation disbursement held pending verification
task_type_original: Referred matter to Initiating Officer under Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act. Requested Enforcement Directorate field verification. Deposited compensation for suspected parcels in government treasury pending investigation. For 5 parcels found genuine after verification released compensation immediately. Remaining 3 parcels kept under attachment order while investigation continues.

cause: 56 displaced families have not received one-time transportation allowance of Rs 50000 as per R&R scheme despite relocation 4 months ago
task_type_original: Verified beneficiary list against R&R entitlement register. Found administrative delay in processing 42 applications and 14 applications with incomplete bank details. Organized camp for bank account verification. Processed all 56 transportation allowance payments in single batch through PFMS. Disbursement completed within 10 working days. Issued payment confirmation receipts to all families.

cause: Centuries-old village temple structure located on acquired land. Community strongly opposing demolition or relocation
task_type_original: Engaged community leaders and temple trust committee for dialogue. Proposed temple relocation with enhanced reconstruction at cost of acquiring authority. Obtained religious advisory committee approval for relocation protocol. Constructed new temple at designated alternative site with all original deity installations. Old site handed over after community-witnessed ritual relocation ceremony. Process took 90 days.

cause: Project requires crossing existing railway line at 3 locations. Railway Board NOC application pending since 8 months with no response
task_type_original: Escalated through state-level railway coordination committee. Submitted revised crossing proposals with safety compliance certifications. Arranged joint site inspection with Railway Divisional Engineer. Deposited railway safety fund deposit as per Railway Board conditions. Obtained conditional NOC for 2 level crossings and 1 road over-bridge within 60 days. Construction design submitted for ROB approval.

task_type: Market Value Dispute for Commercial Land
cause: Commercial property owners in highway alignment demanding 5x compensation over agricultural rates. Claiming commercial use since 15 years
task_type_original: Constituted special valuation committee with two registered valuers and District Revenue Officer. Inspected properties with commercial establishment evidence. Verified municipal trade license records and property tax payment history. Applied commercial land rate for properties with valid commercial use documentation. Issued revised awards with appropriate market value classification. 85% disputes settled through negotiation.

cause: Proposed road alignment conflicting with existing underground gas pipeline between chainage 12+500 and 14+200 requiring major realignment study
task_type_original: Conducted joint utility mapping exercise with GAIL pipeline division using ground penetrating radar. Identified exact pipeline coordinates at 2.1m depth. Evaluated 3 alternative alignment options with cost-benefit analysis. Selected option with minor S-curve avoiding pipeline zone while minimizing additional land acquisition. Revised DPR submitted with modified alignment in 30 days.

cause: 12 parcels belong to Schedule-V tribal landholders. Gram Sabha consent required under PESA Act before acquisition can proceed
task_type_original: Organized Gram Sabha meeting with advance 15-day notice as per PESA guidelines. Presented project details with tribal welfare officer and District Tribal Development Officer. Obtained Gram Sabha resolution with 73% voting in favor after addressing livelihood and R&R concerns. Filed Gram Sabha consent certificate with District Collector. Ensured enhanced R&R package as per tribal sub-plan provisions.

task_type: Government Land Encroached by Private Parties
cause: 18 hectare government land earmarked for project found encroached by 45 families over past 20 years. No formal land titles exist but long possession claimed
task_type_original: Verified encroachment through satellite imagery timeline analysis from 2005 onwards. Categorized encroachers into pre-2013 and post-2013 based on RFCTLARR cutoff. Pre-2013 occupants treated as project affected families eligible for R&R benefits. Post-2013 encroachers served eviction notice. Coordinated phased eviction with police assistance. Provided R&R benefits to 31 eligible families while removing 14 ineligible encroachments.

cause: 127 landless agricultural workers who depend on acquired agricultural land for livelihood not included in compensation scheme
task_type_original: Verified landless worker list through village revenue records and panchayat employment registers. Enrolled eligible workers under RFCTLARR Second Schedule provisions. Disbursed one-time lump sum Rs 500000 per family. Arranged MGNREGA employment guarantee for 150 days. Facilitated skill training enrollment in district industrial training institute. Completed disbursement for all 127 families in 45 days.

task_type: School and Health Facility in R&R Colony Missing
cause: R&R colony established for 120 families but promised primary school and health sub-center construction not yet started after 8 months of relocation
task_type_original: Issued priority construction work orders to PWD contractor with 90-day completion deadline. Arranged temporary schooling facility in community hall with teachers from neighboring village school. Deployed mobile health unit for weekly health camps. Submitted building plans for primary school and health sub-center to block education and health departments. Permanent facilities completed in 4 months. Staff posting ordered by respective departments.

task_type: State Pollution Control Board NOC Delay
cause: SPCB consent to establish for project activities pending since 6 months. Board citing incomplete air quality baseline data for project zone
task_type_original: Engaged NABL-accredited laboratory for comprehensive ambient air quality monitoring at 8 stations for 30 days. Submitted baseline report with PM2.5 PM10 SO2 NO2 readings. Addressed SPCB technical queries on fugitive dust mitigation plan. Revised environmental management plan with enhanced dust suppression measures. Obtained SPCB consent to establish within 45 days of complete submission.

cause: 15 abadi (inhabited settlement) plots within project zone omitted from initial survey due to habitation status. These plots now creating gaps in land assembly
task_type_original: Conducted special survey of abadi plots with settlement officer. Assessed each plot for acquisition necessity versus alignment modification possibility. Found 9 plots essential for project requiring acquisition with R&R. Remaining 6 plots accommodated through minor alignment adjustment. Initiated separate acquisition proceedings for 9 abadi plots with enhanced R&R package including replacement house. Completed survey in 20 days.

cause: General Power of Attorney holder attempting to collect compensation for 7 parcels. Original landholders unaware of acquisition and POA registration
task_type_original: Immediately suspended compensation disbursement for 7 parcels. Notified original landholders through registered post and village-level announcement. Filed complaint with Sub-Registrar regarding suspected fraudulent POA registration. Directed compensation payment only to original title holders after physical verification with Aadhaar authentication. Reported matter to local police station for criminal investigation. All 7 genuine landholders received compensation directly.

task_type: Multiple Award Dragging Due to Court Cases
cause: 23 reference cases pending under Section 64 RFCTLARR in LARR Authority. Average hearing interval of 45 days causing 18-month delays
task_type_original: Filed application for expedited hearing citing project timeline imperatives. Requested LARR Authority to club similar category references for batch hearing. Engaged dedicated government advocate for daily cause list monitoring. Conducted out-of-court settlement negotiations through District Lok Adalat. Settled 15 of 23 cases through mutual consent. Remaining 8 cases given 15-day interval hearing schedule by LARR Authority.

cause: Registered tenant farmers on 12 parcels claiming separate compensation rights. Landowners disputing tenant claims and demanding full compensation
task_type_original: Verified tenancy records from revenue department. Confirmed 8 valid registered tenancy agreements. Applied compensation sharing formula as per state tenancy act provisions. Tenants received 40% of compensation for 8 verified parcels. Remaining 4 unregistered tenant claims referred to SDM for adjudication. Both landowner and tenant received separate award letters with clear entitlement breakup.

cause: Optical fiber cable and water pipeline running through 8 parcels not reflected in revenue records or project survey maps
task_type_original: Conducted comprehensive underground utility survey using ground penetrating radar and cable locator equipment. Identified OFC route at 1.2m depth and water pipeline at 1.8m depth. Coordinated with telecom operator and water supply department for utility shifting feasibility. Prepared utility shifting plan with cost estimates. Utility shifting completed before construction commencement. Updated project survey maps with utility corridors.

task_type: Displaced Families Protesting at Project Site
cause: 45 displaced families staging continuous dharna at project site entrance blocking construction vehicles for 12 days demanding better R&R benefits
task_type_original: Deployed SDM for immediate dialogue with protest leaders. Identified specific grievances including delayed house allotment and missing livelihood assistance. Fast-tracked 28 pending house allotments in R&R colony. Arranged bank linkage for 17 families for self-employment loans. Issued written commitment letter from District Collector for remaining pending entitlements with timeline. Protest called off after 3 days of negotiation.

cause: NGO challenged EIA report before National Green Tribunal citing inadequate public consultation and incomplete biodiversity assessment
task_type_original: Filed detailed counter-reply with complete public hearing documentation including attendance registers and video recordings. Submitted supplementary biodiversity assessment prepared by accredited ecological consultant. Provided evidence of newspaper advertisements and village-level notices for public hearing. NGT directed additional biodiversity survey for specific area. Completed supplementary study in 60 days. NGT cleared project with additional conditions.

task_type: Land Price Inflation Due to Project Announcement
cause: Land transaction prices in project zone artificially inflated 400% after Section 4 notification. Using inflated rates would increase project cost by Rs 200 crore
task_type_original: Constituted district-level land valuation committee with 3 registered valuers. Analyzed pre-notification (3-year average) transaction data from Sub-Registrar records. Identified 23 suspicious transactions with inflated circle rates filed after notification date. Excluded post-notification speculative transactions from market value determination as per RFCTLARR guidelines. Applied pre-notification average rate with statutory multiplication factor and solatium.

cause: Family partition of ancestral property done through oral agreement but no registered partition deed. 4 brothers claiming individual shares from undivided HUF property
task_type_original: Conducted family conference with all 4 claimants and village revenue officials. Verified oral partition claims against actual physical possession and cultivation records. Facilitated immediate registration of partition deed at Sub-Registrar office with fee waiver for acquisition-affected families. Updated revenue mutation records to reflect individual holdings. Issued separate awards to each brother as per registered partition share.

cause: During initial earthwork possible archaeological remains discovered at chainage 28+400 to 28+900 requiring ASI inspection and potential site preservation
task_type_original: Immediately halted construction activity in 500m zone. Notified Archaeological Survey of India regional circle for emergency inspection. ASI team conducted preliminary assessment within 15 days. Identified remains as locally significant but not nationally protected. Obtained ASI clearance with condition of supervised excavation and documentation. Arranged rescue archaeology for artifact recovery before construction resumption. Work resumed after 45-day ASI clearance process.

task_type: Revenue Record Mismatch Between Patwari and Tehsil
cause: Land area recorded in Patwari register differs from Tehsil jamabandi records for 34 parcels. Discrepancy ranges from 5% to 22%
task_type_original: Deployed senior revenue inspector for field verification of all 34 parcels. Conducted chain survey with Patwari and independent surveyor. Cross-verified with historical mutation records and latest satellite imagery. Found Patwari records more accurate for 21 parcels where field boundaries matched. Corrected Tehsil records through revenue court orders. Updated both registers with verified measurements for all 34 parcels.

cause: Minority community landholders in 2 villages expressing apprehension about displacement and demanding special protection guarantees
task_type_original: Organized special consultation meeting with community leaders and District Minority Welfare Officer. Provided translated project information documents in community language. Ensured mosque and community burial ground areas excluded from acquisition through minor alignment modification. Guaranteed equivalent community infrastructure in R&R colony. Issued written undertakings from District Collector for community welfare facilities. Community cooperation obtained.

cause: 3.2 hectare seasonal wetland area identified within acquisition zone after monsoon. Not reflected in pre-monsoon survey maps. Environmental sensitivity concern
task_type_original: Commissioned wetland ecological assessment by MOEF-empanelled environmental consultant. Conducted multi-season biodiversity survey covering 4 months. Found wetland supports 12 migratory bird species during winter. Modified project alignment to preserve 2.8 hectare core wetland with 50m buffer zone. Acquired remaining 0.4 hectare with compensatory wetland creation at 3x ratio. Obtained MOEF conditional clearance with wetland monitoring protocol.

cause: 4 hectare agricultural land belongs to religious endowment trust. Trust board requiring government notification and temple commission approval before transfer
task_type_original: Filed requisition with State Endowments Commissioner for land acquisition consent. Submitted project public purpose certificate with District Collector endorsement. Arranged trust board meeting with Project Director presentation. Trust board passed resolution approving land transfer subject to replacement land provision and compensation deposit in trust account. State Endowments Commissioner issued formal transfer order in 60 days.

cause: Annual subsistence annuity of Rs 3000 per month for 78 displaced families not processed for 6 consecutive months despite approved beneficiary list
task_type_original: Investigated processing failure and found budget allocation exhausted in state welfare department head. Submitted emergency supplementary budget demand through District Collector to state government. Arranged interim payment from project contingency fund with state government reimbursement approval. Processed 6-month backlog payment for all 78 families in single PFMS batch. Established automated monthly payment trigger to prevent future lapses.

cause: DGPS survey data for 89 parcels found inaccurate after equipment calibration check revealed 15cm horizontal error exceeding acceptable tolerance
task_type_original: Recalled all survey data collected with faulty equipment between January-March. Sent DGPS receiver for factory recalibration with certificate. Re-surveyed all 89 affected parcels with calibrated equipment over 15 working days. Applied post-processing differential correction using CORS station data. Verified accuracy within 3cm horizontal tolerance. Updated all parcel coordinates in project GIS database and reissued corrected measurement sheets.

cause: 200-year-old historical step-well and colonial-era bridge within acquisition zone. State Heritage Commission objecting to demolition or modification
task_type_original: Engaged heritage conservation architect for structural assessment. Documented step-well and bridge with 3D laser scanning for archival records. Explored alignment alternatives to avoid direct impact on heritage structures. Modified project design to preserve step-well with 20m protective buffer. Colonial bridge retained as pedestrian crossing with structural reinforcement. Heritage Commission approved modified plan with conservation covenant in 45 days.

cause: Revenue records show 23 parcels as agricultural but owners claim conversion to residential through unauthorized construction and claim higher NA rates
task_type_original: Conducted joint inspection with revenue officer and town planning authority. Verified actual land use through satellite imagery and physical inspection. Found 14 parcels with unauthorized construction not reflected in revenue records. Applied hybrid valuation methodology for 14 parcels considering actual use value. Remaining 9 parcels valued at agricultural rate as per revenue records. Issued separate show-cause notices for unauthorized construction regularization.

cause: 17 parcels have existing mortgage liens with cooperative bank for crop loans. Bank demanding mortgage clearance before compensation release
task_type_original: Coordinated tripartite meeting between landholders bank officials and land acquisition officer. Verified outstanding loan amounts against mortgage deeds. Arranged direct loan outstanding deduction from compensation amount with landholder written consent. Bank issued no-objection certificate after loan clearance. Net compensation amount credited directly to landholder bank accounts. Process completed for all 17 parcels within 20 working days.

cause: R&R colony water treatment plant and sewage system installed but not commissioned. 85 families using untreated water for 3 months
task_type_original: Deployed public health engineering team for emergency inspection. Found electrical connection for pump house not completed. Arranged emergency power connection through state electricity board priority request. Commissioned water treatment plant within 10 days. Tested water quality through district public health laboratory. Activated sewage treatment system with trained operator. Arranged interim water tanker supply until commissioning. System fully operational within 15 days.

cause: Project alignment requires 2.5 km passage through defense cantonment area. Ministry of Defense NOC process initiated but response pending 11 months
task_type_original: Escalated through inter-ministerial coordination mechanism at Secretary level. Submitted revised alignment proposal minimizing defense land requirement from 8 hectare to 3.2 hectare. Arranged joint inspection with Cantonment Board Executive Officer. Agreed on construction methodology limiting security zone disruption. Defense Ministry issued conditional NOC with supervised construction and temporary security perimeter conditions. Total processing time 14 months.

cause: 16 parcels situated in irrigation canal command area with canal easement rights. Irrigation department objecting to any construction within 30m of canal bank
task_type_original: Arranged joint inspection with Executive Engineer Irrigation Division. Assessed canal easement requirements and structural safety distances. Negotiated reduced buffer zone from 30m to 15m based on canal design capacity and bank stability report. Obtained formal NOC from Irrigation Department with condition of canal bank protection works. Designed retaining wall along canal section at project cost. Updated alignment within modified buffer zone parameters.

cause: Landholders in same village receiving different per-acre compensation due to phased acquisition over 3 years with changing circle rates creating resentment
task_type_original: Reviewed all 3 phases of acquisition award data. Found Phase-1 awards were at 2022 circle rates while Phase-3 used 2025 rates resulting in 65% differential. Explored supplementary compensation for Phase-1 landholders through administrative discretion. State government approved one-time equalization payment to Phase-1 holders to bring parity with Phase-3 rates. Disbursed equalization amount to 89 Phase-1 affected families. Published transparent compensation comparison chart in panchayat office.

task_type: NRI Landholder Cannot Appear for Process
cause: 8 parcels owned by NRI landholders residing in UAE and USA. Unable to appear personally for joint measurement and award acceptance
task_type_original: Arranged video conference facility at District Collector office for NRI landholder participation in proceedings. Accepted notarized and apostilled Power of Attorney from Indian embassy attested representatives. Conducted virtual joint measurement verification through live drone feed. Award acceptance documents executed through authorized POA holders with FCRA compliance. Compensation deposited in NRE accounts after RBI compliance verification.

task_type: Landmine and UXO Suspected in Former Military Range
cause: Acquired land was former military firing range. UXO survey required before any construction or ground disturbance activities can commence
task_type_original: Engaged Army Ordnance Corps bomb disposal team for systematic UXO survey. Conducted metal detector and magnetometer sweep of entire 45 hectare area in grid pattern. Found and safely disposed 3 unexploded mortar rounds and 12 detonators. Issued mine-clearance certificate after 3 rounds of sweep verification. Declared area safe for construction activity. Maintained safety protocol documentation for future reference.

cause: Available cadastral maps at 1:4000 scale insufficient for detailed design survey. Need 1:500 scale mapping for 120 hectare acquisition zone
task_type_original: Commissioned 1:500 scale topographic survey using drone photogrammetry and RTK-GPS ground control. Survey covered complete 120 hectare zone with 10cm contour interval. Generated Digital Terrain Model and Digital Surface Model. Created detailed parcellation map with structure inventory. Delivered survey data in multiple formats compatible with AutoCAD and GIS platforms. Survey completed in 25 working days.

cause: Landholders demanding multiplication factor of 2.0 for rural land while district applying 1.0 factor. RFCTLARR Act interpretation dispute
task_type_original: Reviewed RFCTLARR First Schedule provisions for multiplication factor determination. Analyzed distance from nearest urban agglomeration and population density criteria. Found village falls within 20 km from municipal corporation limits qualifying for higher factor. Applied multiplication factor 1.5 based on distance slab calculation. Issued revised awards with corrected multiplication factor. Communicated computation methodology transparently to all landholders.

cause: State Biodiversity Board rejecting forest diversion application citing incomplete biodiversity impact assessment and missing flora fauna inventory
task_type_original: Engaged Botanical Survey of India and Zoological Survey of India accredited consultant team. Conducted 90-day multi-season biodiversity survey with camera traps and quadrat sampling. Identified 234 plant species and 67 fauna species. No critically endangered species found in project zone. Prepared comprehensive BIA report with biodiversity offset plan. Submitted to State Biodiversity Board with revised diversion application. Board approved after 45-day review period.

cause: 32 marginal farmer families demanding agricultural land in lieu of monetary compensation as per RFCTLARR provisions
task_type_original: Explored available government agricultural land in block jurisdiction. Found 18 hectare cultivable wasteland in adjacent village suitable for redistribution. Arranged land development works including leveling and irrigation bore wells. Allotted 0.5 hectare developed agricultural land to each of 32 eligible families. Registered allotment in family name with non-alienation clause for 10 years. Remaining families opting for cash compensation processed through normal award.

cause: Revenue records show 5 parcels as Nazul government land but current possession papers show private ownership through old conversion orders now missing from official files
task_type_original: Conducted archival search in old revenue records room for conversion orders from 1970-1990 period. Found 3 conversion orders in damaged files which were digitally restored and authenticated. For 2 missing conversion orders verified through mutation chain and tax payment history spanning 40 years. Revenue officer issued fresh certified copies based on reconstructed records. Updated digital land records with complete ownership chain documentation.

cause: Annual monsoon flooding of low-lying acquired land parcels preventing physical possession and commencement of construction for 4 months annually
task_type_original: Conducted flood level analysis with Water Resources Department hydrological data for past 25 years. Designed temporary flood protection bund around construction zone. Scheduled construction activities in 8-month dry window. Arranged dewatering pumps for early monsoon period. Implemented flood-resilient construction methodology for foundations. Advanced possession timeline to pre-monsoon period for maximum construction window.

cause: 47 mutation cases pending in revenue court for acquired parcels. Acquisition officer unable to determine rightful compensation recipients
task_type_original: Filed applications in revenue court for expedited disposal of acquisition-related mutations. Revenue court granted priority hearing for all 47 cases. Arranged compilation of complete documentation for each case including sale deeds will certificates and family trees. 38 cases disposed in 30 days through fast-track process. Compensation for 9 contested cases deposited in court registry pending final mutation orders.

cause: Social Impact Assessment report validity of 12 months expired before completing acquisition. SIA needs to be redone adding 6-8 months delay
task_type_original: Conducted rapid SIA update study focusing on changes since original study. Found no significant demographic or socioeconomic changes in project zone. Filed application for SIA validity extension with state government citing minimal change report. State government granted 6-month extension based on update report. Simultaneously fast-tracked remaining acquisition steps to complete within extension period. Completed acquisition proceedings within 4 months of extension grant.

cause: Drone survey for 300 hectare project zone denied by Airport Authority due to proximity to civil aerodrome restricted airspace zone
task_type_original: Applied for specific drone operation permission through Digital Sky portal with detailed flight plan. Obtained UAOP from DGCA for survey-grade drone operations at restricted altitude below 120m AGL. Coordinated time-specific flight windows with airport ATC avoiding aircraft approach hours. Completed aerial survey in 8 pre-approved flight windows over 12 days. Delivered high-resolution orthomosaic and DEM data for complete project zone.

cause: 2.8 hectare agricultural land registered as Wakf property in state Wakf Board records. Acquisition requires Wakf Board formal concurrence
task_type_original: Submitted acquisition proposal to State Wakf Board with project public purpose certificate and District Collector recommendation. Arranged Wakf Board inspection committee visit to project site. Proposed compensation deposit in Wakf Fund for equivalent land purchase. Board passed resolution approving acquisition with condition of replacement agricultural land endowment. Formal concurrence letter issued in 75 days.

task_type: Circle Rate Not Updated Since 5 Years
cause: District circle rates last revised in 2019. Current market values 3x higher than circle rates leading to massive under-compensation complaints
task_type_original: Requested District Collector to constitute special rate determination committee. Collected 5 years of registered sale deed data from 4 adjacent villages. Applied average actual transaction value with normalization for extreme outlier transactions. Used recalculated fair market value exceeding circle rate as base for RFCTLARR computation. Added mandatory multiplication factor solatium and interest. Issued enhanced awards satisfying 87% of affected landholders.

task_type: Elderly and Disabled Persons Special Assistance
cause: 14 elderly persons above 70 years and 6 physically disabled persons unable to manage relocation process independently
task_type_original: Arranged dedicated social worker for each vulnerable family. Provided door-to-door transportation assistance on relocation day. Ensured ground floor allotment in R&R colony for all 6 disabled persons. Arranged Aadhaar update and pension transfer to new address. Coordinated with district hospital for medical record transfer. Provided additional one-time assistance of Rs 25000 from project welfare fund for relocation expenses.

cause: 0.8 hectare mangrove patch discovered within project zone during detailed ecological survey. CRZ authority raising environmental sensitivity concerns
task_type_original: Commissioned CRZ demarcation survey by authorized CRZ agency. Confirmed 0.8 hectare falls within CRZ-1A category requiring complete protection. Modified project alignment to maintain 50m buffer from mangrove boundary. Obtained CRZ clearance from State Coastal Zone Management Authority with monitoring conditions. Implemented mangrove conservation plan with annual health monitoring protocol.

cause: Local political leaders mobilizing landholders against giving possession despite full compensation. Creating law and order situation during possession attempts
task_type_original: District Magistrate convened all-party meeting explaining project public interest and statutory provisions. Arranged separate meetings with political leaders addressing specific concerns. Provided transparent documentation of compensation adequacy and R&R provisions. Deployed Section 144 prohibitory order for peaceful possession. Executed possession under SDM supervision with adequate police deployment. Maintained video documentation of entire peaceful possession process.

cause: Project zone overlaps with proposed new irrigation canal command area. Irrigation department claiming priority for canal alignment
task_type_original: Arranged inter-departmental coordination meeting chaired by District Collector. Reviewed both project alignments on common GIS platform. Identified 12 hectare overlap zone where both alignments conflict. Developed joint solution with modified irrigation canal alignment using syphon crossing under project road. Both departments agreed on modified alignment saving 8 months of potential litigation. Joint modified DPR submitted for approval.

cause: Landholders who purchased land recently demanding refund of stamp duty and registration fees paid as land is now being acquired at same price
task_type_original: Verified purchase transaction details for affected landholders from Sub-Registrar records. Identified 15 parcels purchased within 3 years of acquisition notification. Applied RFCTLARR provision for stamp duty reimbursement for purchases within 3 years of notification. Processed stamp duty refund applications through Registration Department. Refund amounts included in enhanced compensation calculation. All 15 cases processed within 30 days.

cause: Traditional potter community of 23 families losing access to clay deposit area essential for their hereditary livelihood occupation
task_type_original: Identified alternative clay deposit area 4 km from proposed R&R colony. Arranged transportation facility for daily access to new clay source. Provided pottery wheel modernization equipment under district industrial scheme. Facilitated GI tag application for community pottery product. Established sales outlet in nearest town market. Ensured community workshop space in R&R colony layout plan. Artisan families accepted relocation with livelihood continuity guarantee.

cause: Land ownership under appeal in Revenue Court. Both parties claiming title based on conflicting sale deeds from different periods
task_type_original: Obtained certified copies of both sale deeds from Sub-Registrar. Traced complete ownership chain from original settlement record. Revenue Court expedited hearing based on acquisition urgency request. Court determined valid title based on earlier registration date and continuous possession evidence. Compensation directed to rightful owner. Appeal period of 30 days observed before disbursement.

cause: Agricultural land converted to brick kiln operation 10 years ago but land use change not reflected in revenue records. Owner demanding industrial rate compensation
task_type_original: Conducted joint inspection with revenue officer and district industrial officer. Verified brick kiln operation through electricity bills and trade license history. Confirmed actual land use as industrial for past 10 years despite revenue record showing agricultural. Revenue officer issued rectification entry for land use conversion. Compensation calculated at industrial rate based on actual use with documented evidence. Updated revenue records accordingly.

cause: Mango orchard with 450 fruit-bearing trees on 8 hectare acquired land. Tree valuation methodology disputed between district rate and actual yield calculation
task_type_original: Engaged district horticulture officer for tree-by-tree assessment including species age girth and annual yield estimation. Applied capitalized value method based on net annual income from fruit yield over remaining productive life. Calculated separately for 300 bearing trees and 150 non-bearing trees. Total tree compensation exceeded district schedule rate by 280%. Landholders accepted revised tree valuation. Paid timber value separately for non-fruit trees.

task_type: Unauthorized Commercial Complex on Acquired Land
cause: Unauthorized 3-story commercial complex constructed on acquired government land housing 28 shops and 6 offices. Occupants demanding rehabilitation
task_type_original: Served statutory eviction notice under Public Premises Act with 30-day compliance deadline. Identified tenants with formal lease agreements versus encroachers. Arranged alternative market space in nearby commercial area for legitimate shopkeepers. Provided 3-month transition period for business relocation. Executed phased eviction with municipal demolition squad for structural removal. Cleared site and erected security fencing. Filed recovery proceedings against original encroacher for land restoration costs.

cause: State Board for Wildlife meeting not convened for 9 months. Project wildlife clearance application pending on agenda since 6 months
task_type_original: Requested Chief Wildlife Warden to flag project in next Board meeting agenda as priority item. Submitted complete wildlife mitigation plan with animal passage design specifications. Followed up through state government principal secretary intervention. Board meeting finally convened with project as first agenda item. Obtained conditional clearance with mandatory wildlife corridor construction and 5-year monitoring requirement. Total processing time 12 months.

cause: Accumulated 12% interest on delayed compensation for 234 landholders creating Rs 8.5 crore additional liability not budgeted in original project estimate
task_type_original: Prepared detailed interest computation statement for all 234 cases with daily interest calculation. Submitted revised cost estimate incorporating interest liability to administrative department. Obtained supplementary budget approval from state planning department. Prioritized compensation disbursement to stop further interest accumulation. Processed all pending payments within 45 days. Implemented automated interest calculator in LA management software to track future liability in real-time.

cause: Coastal fishing community of 67 families losing access to traditional fishing grounds due to port expansion project acquisition
task_type_original: Arranged comprehensive livelihood assessment with district fisheries officer. Identified alternative fishing area 3 km south with similar catch potential. Provided motorized boat upgrade for 40 traditional boat families to access new fishing ground. Established fish drying yard and cold storage facility near R&R colony. Enrolled 27 families in aquaculture training for inland fish farming. Ensured continued access to existing fishing harbor through designated pathway.

cause: 14 hectare land under acquisition is subject to pending ceiling proceedings under State Land Ceiling Act. Surplus land determination not finalized
task_type_original: Coordinated with District Land Ceiling Authority for expedited disposal of pending proceedings. Revenue court prioritized ceiling cases for acquisition-affected lands. Determined 9 hectare as ceiling surplus vesting in government. Remaining 5 hectare confirmed as within ceiling limit belonging to landholder. Government land portion required no compensation. Landholder portion compensated at full market rate. Ceiling proceedings concluded in 60 days with dedicated court hearings.

cause: Coastal erosion over past decade reduced actual land area by 15-30% compared to revenue records for 12 seaside parcels
task_type_original: Conducted current shoreline mapping using satellite imagery and field verification. Compared with revenue map boundaries showing significant erosion. Established actual existing land area through GPS survey. Compensation calculated based on current actual area not revenue record area. Provided separate erosion loss compensation at reduced rate for lost area. Updated revenue records with current land boundaries and erosion annotation.

cause: Valid mining lease exists on 6 hectare acquired land with 8 years remaining. Leaseholder demanding compensation for loss of mining rights and invested infrastructure
task_type_original: Verified mining lease validity and remaining term with District Mining Officer. Assessed invested infrastructure value through independent chartered engineer valuation. Calculated loss of mining rights compensation based on average annual royalty and projected revenue for remaining lease period. Negotiated settlement including infrastructure relocation assistance. Mining department issued lease cancellation order after full compensation payment. Site rehabilitated and handed over for project use.

cause: Compensation for 11 jointly owned parcels stuck due to co-owners disagreeing on proportion of compensation share
task_type_original: Reviewed registered ownership documents for share determination. Where registered shares existed applied proportional distribution. For undivided joint holdings arranged mediation through SDM office. 7 cases resolved through mutual agreement documented in mediation minutes. Remaining 4 cases with irreconcilable disputes compensation deposited in Reference Court under Section 77. Court to determine individual shares and distribute. This approach prevented blocking of compensation for willing co-owners.

cause: 3 consecutive satellite imagery acquisitions for project zone failed due to persistent cloud cover during monsoon season affecting survey timeline
task_type_original: Ordered high-resolution radar satellite imagery (SAR) unaffected by cloud cover as alternative. Procured CARTOSAT-3 stereo pair from ISRO for cloud-free terrain modeling. Supplemented with ground control survey points at 50m intervals. Generated DEM from radar data with ground-truthing verification. Completed terrain mapping without waiting for optical satellite pass. Delivered survey products within 3 weeks of SAR data acquisition.

cause: Village common grazing land of 12 hectare acquired for project. Cattle-owning community demanding compensation for loss of grazing rights affecting 200 households
task_type_original: Assessed actual usage through livestock census and grazing pattern study. Identified alternative grazing area 3 km from village on forest department grassland with grazing permit. Constructed cattle pathway connecting village to new grazing ground. Compensated village panchayat for common land acquisition. Established silage bank at village level to supplement fodder during lean season. Arranged veterinary mobile unit coverage for relocated grazing area.

cause: MOEF requiring carbon sequestration offset plan for clearing 15000 trees in project zone. No standard methodology available at state level
task_type_original: Engaged carbon accounting specialist from TERI for offset calculation. Estimated total carbon stock in 15000 trees at 8500 tonnes CO2 equivalent. Designed compensatory plantation plan with 3:1 ratio covering 45000 saplings. Identified 5 plantation sites across 3 districts with committed 5-year maintenance plan. Registered carbon offset project under voluntary carbon standard. Submitted carbon offset plan with third-party verification to MOEF. Approved in 90 days.

task_type: Land Donated to Government But Not Transferred
cause: 8 parcels shown as donated to government for school construction 30 years ago but formal transfer never executed in revenue records. School never built
task_type_original: Traced donation deed and government acceptance order from district archive. Found formal mutation never executed due to administrative oversight. Verified no government structure was ever built on donated land. Original donors heirs petitioned for land return citing non-fulfillment of donation purpose. Revenue court restored land to original donors heirs through mutation order. Subsequent acquisition proceedings initiated with compensation payable to restored owners.

cause: Active village cemetery with historical graves within project zone. Community strongly opposing any disturbance to burial ground
task_type_original: Modified project alignment to completely avoid cemetery area with 50m buffer zone. Where complete avoidance impossible arranged controlled exhumation and reburial at new designated community cemetery with full religious ceremony. New cemetery land provided free of cost by project authority with boundary wall and approach road construction. Community religious leaders supervised entire relocation process. Community agreement documented with video recording.

cause: 5 parcels located in disputed territory between two state jurisdictions. Both state revenue departments claiming territorial jurisdiction
task_type_original: Referred matter to Survey of India for authoritative border demarcation verification. Obtained certified state boundary coordinates from SOI records. Determined 3 parcels fall in state A and 2 parcels in state B jurisdiction. Initiated separate acquisition proceedings in respective state jurisdictions. Arranged inter-state coordination committee for seamless execution. Both state collectors issued concurrent notifications for synchronized acquisition process.

cause: 4 wind energy turbines installed on acquired land parcels. Windmill operators demanding compensation for structure value and loss of power generation income
task_type_original: Engaged independent structural engineer and chartered accountant for dual valuation. Structural value assessed based on depreciated replacement cost of turbines towers and foundations. Revenue loss calculated from power purchase agreement remaining term and average generation data. Total compensation included structure depreciated value plus present value of future power revenue. Facilitated turbine relocation to alternative site where feasible for 2 units. Paid full compensation for 2 units requiring decommissioning.

task_type: Marriage Hall Demand in R&R Colony
cause: R&R colony community demanding construction of marriage hall and community center not included in original R&R scheme infrastructure list
task_type_original: Assessed community facility requirements through participatory needs assessment survey. Found marriage hall rated highest priority by 89% of relocated families. Identified budget provision under RFCTLARR community infrastructure head. Designed multi-purpose community hall serving as marriage venue meeting space and cultural center. Construction cost Rs 45 lakh approved from project R&R budget. Work order issued with 6-month completion timeline. Community management committee formed for future maintenance.

cause: Traditional sacred grove revered by tribal community located within forest diversion zone. Community opposing any tree felling in sacred grove area
task_type_original: Conducted ethnobotanical study of sacred grove documenting cultural significance and biodiversity value. Found grove contains 3 rare medicinal plant species. Modified project alignment to preserve entire sacred grove with 100m protective buffer. Declared sacred grove as community conserved area under Biological Diversity Act. Installed boundary demarcation and signage. Community granted formal management rights through Gram Sabha resolution. Project alignment extended by 200m to avoid grove. Additional land acquisition for modified alignment processed within 30 days.

cause: Consolidation proceedings under state consolidation act in progress for 3 villages overlapping with project zone. No individual parcel numbers assigned yet
task_type_original: Coordinated with Consolidation Officer for expedited finalization of acquisition zone parcels. Requested carving out project zone from consolidation proceedings. Consolidation officer issued interim allotment numbers for acquisition zone parcels. Individual measurement and valuation conducted based on interim parcel designations. Compensation calculated and deposited subject to final consolidation settlement. Post-consolidation adjustment mechanism agreed upon for any area variation in final settlement records.
